implementation: Explicit native Custom dispatch uses the selected provider requirement and host-issued FactAuthority. Borrowed FactsRequestView and owned requests share validators; the callback does not require copying the whole tree through NDF.

FactsEmitter admits sources, mappings and typed diagnostics/events before accepting them into the operation collector. Subsequent stops preserve those records and original usage; raw deltas returned to an already stopped parent are not admitted.

Authorized FactDelta application preserves sparse IDs and enforces namespace/root and Global duplicate rules. Native bindings after external IDs allocate valid successors and return typed exhaustion at the u64 boundary. Source-less duplicate definitions never acquire invented source spans.

Explicit resolution updates preserve issuance stages. Canonical invocation targets, selected provider/authority and before/after transitions form a retained history whose chains and final resolutions are checked at the portable boundary.

Keyed Definition/References queries select exact-source half-open UTF-8 occurrences, follow final Entity IDs and retain all ambiguous candidates in resolver order. They distinguish no selection, unresolved, free input, deferred and source-less targets. Reference role and ambiguity options are explicit.

Real first-receiver QueryRequest CBOR decoding invokes the production query API. Reply decoding checks the corresponding request, source closure, URI/ranges, candidate IDs and options. Raw replies remain data and never manufacture native execution proof.

independent_review.custom: Original compile/parse/native callback probes cover sparse ID 100 and MAX-1 through MAX/exhaustion, Global duplicates without source positions, immutable Open resolution history and denied updates, Foreign roots, report/map emission and typed partial stops. The independent 289-budget map/emitter sweep had 71 stops, including 24 after formal emission; every partial FactSet and real CBOR closure was checked.
independent_review.query: Seven original inputs and eleven selected byte positions cover Let initialization, nested/sibling shadowing, Unicode, foreign roots, all ambiguous candidates and escaped Text source positions. Additional source-less sparse targets, explicit resolution updates and four real Import/Export option combinations match native and first-receiver CBOR results. Managed Custom 9 and query 6 tests and all 33 WASI binding tests passed independently.
independent_review.root_confirmation: Root reran all six gates in the isolated validation worktree and verified 46 frozen source/schema/spec/review files against raw byte hashes and staged Git blobs. The explicit Import test helper override transferred ownership from the native implementer to the common-contract implementer.
